translation.name: Suha' Maseho: Kadadiam anna Pa'dandiam Bakahu

content: Ishak tohho dio Gerar
Pissam wattu sule oom kakobeam susi indo anna tubopi Abraham. Napolalam le'ba' Ishak lako Abimelekh tomahajanna to Filistin anna tohhoi dio Gerar,
aka puha umpa'paitaam kalena DEBATA lako Ishak anna nauaanni: “Daa ullao lako Mesir, tohho dioko indo to la kutulasangko.

Etangko too pessihuhu anna la kukambi'ko sola kutamba'. Ingganna inde pa'lembängam la kupadokkoangko lisu pala'mu sule lako pessubummu. Aka la kupasule lako pa'dandiangku, indo puha kudandi lako ambemu Abraham.
Anna la kupalohom banne taummu susi budanna bintä yabo langi' anna inde pa'lembängam la kupadokkoam asam lisu pala'na pessubummu. Anna pessubummu la kupa'polalanni pa'tamba' lako issinna lino.
Ia anna la kutamba'koa' aka untuhu'i liu tula'ku Abraham anna naanti manda' natobe matoto' ingganna kada pepaondongangku, pahentaku, sola pelahangangku.”
Iya iam too anna tohho diom Gerar Ishak.

Tappana napekutanaanni pa'botto diona bainena, iya nauam Ishak: “Indee adingku hi to kao.” Moka muuai: “Baineku,” aka naua inabanna: “Deem manii pa'botto umpateiä' aka umpohäe Ribka aka mapi'dä' hupanna.”
Masäe-säei tohho Ishak dio indo ongeam, iya ma'pahandam-handammi Abimelekh tomahajanna to Filistin dio suleba'na, iya muitam Ishak sianda'i lelem Ribka.
Iya untambaim Ishak anna nauaanni: “Bainemu hiko päläe' itim baine, akanna muua hiko: ‘Adingku’?” Iya natimba'im Ishak naua: “Aka kupenaba-nabaam kuua deem manii umpateiä' ke kuuai: ‘Baineku’.”
Nauaammi Abimelekh: “Akanna ma'pateem ongko duka'? Kahapa too deemmi taungku umpempakoi bainemu, iya umpaalaingkam kami' sala.”
Iya napa'pahentaammi Abimelekh lako ingganna pakketauanna naua: “Menna-menna la ussägäi Ishak, battu haka bainena, tä' mala tala dipatei.”
Tappana lambi' wattunna pengkähängam, mangngambo'um duka' Ishak, iya tiluppi' sahatu' pa'taunna aka natamba' DEBATA.
Tuttuam kehängäm katomakakaanna, sampe sugi' tangkalantungam.
Tä' deem pada sabuda dombana, bekena, sapinna anna sabua'na, nasuhum nakembuhui to Filistin.
Lambi' natambunni asam to Filistin indo bujum puha nabo'bä' sabua'na Abraham, ambena Ishak, indo anna tubopi.
Iya ma'kadam Abimelekh lako Ishak naua: “Äläiko lao kalemu illaam mai inde botto litä'ki aka kuasa puha hangko iko anna la kami'.”
Iya le'ba'um Ishak lu lako lembä Gerar anna tohho dioi mebahum.
Dioi, iya nakahoi asammi sule Ishak indo bujum nabo'bä' Abraham indo anna tubopi, aka natambunni to Filistin tappana mate Abraham. Anna nasangai asam sule Ishak indo bujum susi passangainna Abraham.
Pissam wattu umbo'bä' bujum sabua'na Ishak dio lembä ia too, iya ullambi'um uwai tä' deem pada sabuda.
Sapo' keaha' indo to ma'kambi' dio Gerar lako indo to ma'kambi'na Ishak naua: “Anungki hi to kami',” sampe nasikalla-kallai. Iam too anna nasangaim Ishak indo bujum, Esek, kalembasanna Kasikallaam.
Iya nabo'bä' polem ia indo sabua'na Ishak bujum senga' sapo' napa'keahasam pole oo, sampe nasikalla-kallai oo. Iya nasangaim ia Ishak, Sitna, kalembasanna Kasipobaliam.

Mentieli' pole oom kapentallunna umbo'bä' bujum. Iya tä'um pole' napa'keahasam. Iam too anna nasangaim ia Ishak, Rehobot, kalembasanna Dipalonda, aka naua: “Temo nabeemmakia' DEBATA kalondaam tohho illaam inde pa'lembängam la membea' lampa'.”
Mane mengkalaoi Ishak lu lako Bersyeba.

Bengii umpa'paitaammi kalena DEBATA lako Ishak anna ma'kadai naua: “Kaom too inde Puang Allataala to napenombai ambemu Abraham. Daa ummahea' aka la kuundu'ko. La kutamba'ko anna lohonni banne taummu aka puha kudandi lako sabua'ku Abraham.”
Puhai ia too, umpapiam pehumalasam anna umpenombai DEBATA dio indo ongeam. Iya mebahummi Ishak eta, anna umbo'bä' polei bujum sabua'na.
Iya sulem Abimelekh dio mai Gerar napasola Ahuzat to si umbalii ma'pikki' anna Pikhol pangngulu sohodadunna umpellambi'i Ishak.
Iya mekutanam Ishak naua: “Akanna sulekoa' umpellambi'iä'? Kusanga ungkahi'di'ä' indo lessu' sampe ussuaä' illaam mai botto litä'mua'.”
Natimba'um naua: “Kiissam kiua iko to naundu'ko DEBATA. Dadi kiua: Mapia ke umpadeengkia' kasitallisam. La sitalli'kia'

anna mala tä'ko deem la ma'pogau' kadake lako kami', umba susi kami' duka' tä'kam deem la ma'gau' kadake matim. Sapo' tontäkam ma'pogau' mapia matim anna kipäbäingko le'ba' sola kamasannangam indo lessu'. Anna abana hia to natamba'ko DEBATA.”
Iya natosabe manappam Ishak, napande anna napaihu'.
Makale'nai mebengngi', sitalli'um pole'. Puhai ia too, nauaammi Ishak: “La masakke hakoa' too illaam pangngola-lalangammu.”
Allo eta siam too anna sulei sabua'na Ishak ma'tula' naua: “Indo bujum kibo'bä' kilambi'um uwai.”
Iya nasangaim Ishak indo bujum, Syeba, kalembasanna Kasitallisam. Susim too tulasanna anna disangai indo kota Bersyeba
sule lako temo.
Tappana appa' puloi taunna Esau, iya umpobainem dua änä' daha to buttu dio mai Het, isanga Yudit, änä'na Beeri, anna Basmat, änä'na Elon.
Baine ia too umpomasussa penabanna Ishak sola Ribka.
